name: Cslib.FreeM.FreeReader.run_withReader
lines: ⊢ (withTheReader σ f m).run s = m.run (f s)
⊢ (withTheReader σ f (FreeM.pure a)).run s = run (FreeM.pure a) (f s)
ih : ∀ (a : ι✝) (s : σ), (withTheReader σ f (cont a)).run s = run (cont a) (f s)
⊢ (withTheReader σ f (liftBind op cont)).run s = run (liftBind op cont) (f s)
ih : ∀ (a s : σ), (withTheReader σ f (cont a)).run s = run (cont a) (f s)
⊢ (withTheReader σ f (liftBind ReaderF.read cont)).run s = run (liftBind ReaderF.read cont) (f s)

steps.tactic:
induction m generalizing s with
| pure a => rfl
| liftBind op cont ih =>
  cases op
  simpa [withTheReader, instMonadWithReaderOf, run] using! (ih (f s) s)
simpa [withTheReader, instMonadWithReaderOf, run] using! (ih (f s) s)
